summary.text: Van Wanggaard is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 21, based in Racine, and was elected to the Senate in 2010.
He chairs the Committee on Judiciary and Public Safety and has held the Majority Caucus Chair position.

paragraphs.text: Wanggaard was born in Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, in April 1952, and is married with two children and three grandchildren.
He graduated from Racine Lutheran High School in 1970 and the Legislature's page lists his training at the Racine Police Academy and the Wisconsin State Patrol Academy, among other programs.
The page describes him as a full-time legislator and a retired traffic investigator with the Racine Police Department.
He served on the Racine County Board from 2002 to 2011 and on the Racine Police and Fire Commission from 2003 to 2013.
He was elected to the Senate in 2010 and has been reelected since 2014, holding the Majority Caucus Vice Chair position from 2015 to 2017 and the Majority Caucus Chair position in 2017 and 2019.
